mapper.select: SELECT id, title_id, version_no, status, change_type, change_summary, company_name, taxpayer_id, registered_address, phone, bank_name, bank_account, subject_ids_json, created_by, created_at FROM invoice_title_version WHERE title_id = #{titleId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY version_no DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) + 1 FROM invoice_title_version WHERE title_id = #{titleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoice_title_version (title_id, version_no, status, change_type, change_summary, company_name, taxpayer_id, registered_address, phone, bank_name, bank_account, subject_ids_json, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{titleId}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{changeType}, 'EDIT'), #{changeSummary}, #{companyName}, #{taxpayerId}, #{registeredAddress}, #{phone}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccount}, #{subjectIdsJson}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_title_version WHERE title_id = #{titleId}
